rules: identify pre-existing changes before editing public files
do not assume ownership of local pending files
block execution when scope conflicts are found
capture snapshot or diff for every file that will be altered
define rollback for every file touched by the operation

checklist.name: Resolve Working Tree Preconditions
checklist.rollback: do not start public edits if guard fails

checklist.name: Registry and Relationship Verification
postconditions: registry assets and governed relationships confirmed
checklist.rollback: no public rollback needed if verification only

checklist.name: Runtime Mapping Verification
postconditions: physical files, pending local files and missing abstractions reviewed
checklist.rollback: no public rollback needed if verification only

checklist.name: Asset Page Generation or Controlled Update
postconditions: only approved pages generated or updated
checklist.rollback: restore operation-owned page snapshots or remove generated pages

checklist.name: Public Composition Update
preconditions: Home, Blog, Tools and Category impact classified

checklist.name: Breadcrumb and JSON-LD Generation or Update
Sitemap Update
checklist.rollback: remove operation-owned sitemap entries and restore previous lastmod values

checklist.name: Testing
preconditions: public file changes completed in approved scope
checklist.rollback: use operation rollback plan if tests fail after edits

checklist.name: Validation
checklist.rollback: use operation rollback plan if validation fails

checklist.name: Publishing Confirmation
checklist.rollback: activate approved rollback plan if publication is reverted

checklist.name: IndexNow Optional Send
checklist.rollback: external indexing call cannot be undone; use only after approval

checklist.name: Final Validation
checklist.rollback: use operation rollback plan if final validation fails

checklist.name: Publication Log
postconditions: publication log includes changed files, validations, sitemap and indexing impact
checklist.rollback: log rollback event if rollback is executed
